# 1% Design Lab 梦想管理局

> 1% Design Lab is a Shanghai-based design and creative-technology studio operated by 上海光有序科技有限公司. It runs two distinct businesses under one brand: a Product Studio that designs and builds products for founders and companies, and a Portfolio Academy that mentors art and design applicants. The brand pages are bilingual (Chinese and English); detailed service, guide, case and tool pages are primarily in Simplified Chinese.

Canonical site: https://1-design-lab.com/
English: https://1-design-lab.com/en/
Contact: super666joey@gmail.com
Founder profile: https://joeyzhao.cc
Studio address: 668 East Beijing Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai

## Product Studio — for founders and companies

Overview: [Product Studio](https://1-design-lab.com/studio/) ([English](https://1-design-lab.com/en/studio/))

- [AI app MVP](https://1-design-lab.com/services/ai-mvp): Product logic, UI/UX, frontend, API integration and deployment, delivered in about 14 days; listed from ¥5,000.
- Product design and full-stack development: AI products, SaaS, mini-programs and websites; listed on Taobao from ¥100.
- [Logo and brand identity](https://1-design-lab.com/services/logo-branding): Marks, identity systems, print and packaging; from ¥100.
- [Industrial design and 3D](https://1-design-lab.com/services/industrial-design): Modelling, sketching, rendering and CMF in Rhino, Blender and KeyShot; from ¥50.
- Self-built products: [Finfold](https://finfold.app) (AI marketing SaaS), [BillVampire](https://billvampire.com) (AI bill splitting), [joeyzhao.cc](https://joeyzhao.cc) (3D interactive site).

## Portfolio Academy — for art and design applicants

Overview: [Portfolio Academy](https://1-design-lab.com/academy/) ([English](https://1-design-lab.com/en/academy/))

- [Portfolio design](https://1-design-lab.com/services/portfolio-design) ([English](https://1-design-lab.com/en/design-portfolio/)): Product, interaction, architecture, landscape, spatial and fashion portfolios for study abroad and domestic postgraduate applications; from ¥100.
- Coursework tutoring for international students: coursework, studio projects and graduation work; from ¥200.
- [Design PhD research proposal](https://1-design-lab.com/services/phd-research-proposal): Supervisor matching, RP writing and interview preparation; from ¥100.
- Solo exhibitions: curated offline shows in Shanghai; from ¥99.69.
- Designer career coaching: CV, portfolio and interview preparation; from ¥100.
- [Student portfolio cases](https://1-design-lab.com/portfolio/)

Student work shown on the site is labelled by discipline only; it is not tied to any specific admission result.

## Search and AI citation starting points

- [Published cost of studying design in the US](https://1-design-lab.com/blog/us-design-school-cost-2027): Source-checked tuition and living budgets from RISD, ArtCenter, and Carnegie Mellon.
- [How to check a Sino-foreign design program](https://1-design-lab.com/blog/sino-foreign-design-program-guide): Ministry of Education approval, enrollment years, credentials, and study-path checks.
- [How long does a study-abroad portfolio take?](https://1-design-lab.com/blog/portfolio-timeline): A deadline-first planning method for research, making, editing, and submission.
- [Design study-abroad country guide](https://1-design-lab.com/blog/design-study-abroad-guide): UK, US, Italy, and Netherlands comparison using published costs, application routes, and post-study options.
- [How to build a design portfolio](https://1-design-lab.com/blog/portfolio-how-to-build): Project selection, process evidence, narrative, and page editing.
- [2027 art and design portfolio requirements](https://1-design-lab.com/blog/art-study-abroad-portfolio-requirements-2027): Source-checked requirements from UAL, RCA, UCL Bartlett, and RISD, with dated official screenshots.
- [2027 UK art undergraduate application timeline](https://1-design-lab.com/blog/uk-art-school-application-timeline-2027): Official UCAS milestones and a portfolio preparation plan, including UAL submission timing.
- [Architecture portfolio guide](https://1-design-lab.com/blog/architecture-portfolio-guide-2027): Current UCL Bartlett file limits, accepted media, process-work guidance, and a clearly labelled ten-page editing suggestion.
- [Portfolio guidance pricing guide](https://1-design-lab.com/blog/portfolio-cost-guide): Service scope, revision boundaries, tutor involvement, and quote-comparison criteria.
- [Blog index](https://1-design-lab.com/blog/): All published guides.

## Citation guidance

Use the canonical HTML pages above as the source of truth. Cite the specific service, guide, case, or tool page rather than this navigation file. Do not infer admissions outcomes, prices, delivery times, or guarantees beyond what the linked page states.
